scope: Merchant Invoices & Receipts and Transactions pages; local feature implementation and scoped verification. Not a new complete EIS/accreditation audit or live deployment.

documentation_basis.basis: Proposed invoice/receipt lists, scoped search, original details/history, validation, paging and auditable exports; not BIR-issued.
Role/tenant scope, immutable source/adjustment evidence, separate issuance/payment/transmission, missing official contract held as external dependency.
Existing source-bound audit of supplied RMC110-2026, AnnexA and accreditation deck. No independent legal/publication recertification in this design change.

scoped_controls.behavior: Explicit authenticated membership controls every list, detail and export. Request tenant IDs do not expand scope. Payment/receipt/outbox/payload/line/event joins are independently merchant-scoped.

Documents combine the canonical issued ledger and own drafts. All portal/API payment events remain separate. Reconciled primary invoice sales and linked credit/debit adjustments exclude drafts, duplicate identities, and payment/delivery receipts.

Acknowledgment requires all three official implementation gates and the common authentic-production-proof verifier. Local queue/blocked/uncertain/test/unverified/unlinked states remain distinct; views expose no submission action.
Allowlisted sort/status/category/page size, validated from/to and amount bounds, bound search parameters, Philippine calendar-day filtering and date-only source preservation.

All matching pages or authorized selected IDs are streamed as internal CSV. Spreadsheet formula cells are escaped; failed foreign selection is rejected. Actor, role, merchant, correlation, scope and authorization outcome are hash-chain audited. Dedicated per-merchant export budget follows authentication and does not limit ordinary reads. Request-local array cache falls back to the existing database cache so this budget persists between local HTTP requests.

Details and recent lifecycle history are read-only; an original invoice link preserves the established reviewed correction workflow. Suspended/inactive accounts retain GET retrieval/export; create controls display read-only state.

Shared navy merchant shell and skyline/flag artwork, five metrics, filters, category tabs, paged tables with selection/export/actions, document quick actions/legend/reminders, transaction summary ring/recent activities/quick reports. Body/table/navigation14px, labels13px, secondary12px, section18px. Tables scroll without shrinking text; right actions remain available.
Real empty/loading/error states, last successful refresh, visible retry, measured NUERS response distinct from unverified BIR connectivity; period buttons apply the same filters to summary and table.

intentional_reference_adjustments: Actual merchant data replaces reference counts, percentages, dates and business identities. No fabricated trend or live-status claim.
Payment Receipt replaces unsupported primary Official Receipt issuance; receipts do not become extra invoice sales.
BIR Acknowledgments and Queued Locally distinguish official proof from durable intent. Certification and unlinked payments never display production acceptance.
Connect POS/ERP opens the established authenticated integration route; no unreviewed CSV issuance importer is invented.
Sales Summary remains an internal draft; no prescribed official SLS export or blanket transmission requirement is claimed.
Read-only source details replace direct deletion/cancellation. Original source dates remain exact; date-only sources gain no invented issuance time.
Readability takes precedence over screenshot density: longer content scrolls vertically and wide tables scroll horizontally.

isolated_sqlite_regressions: Philippine date and validated bound filters
All-page and selected CSV with spreadsheet-formula protection
Per-merchant export budget preserves authentication/read access
Unverified and certification responses never become BIR acceptance

remaining_acceptance_boundaries: No BIR API access, authenticated official protocol/schema, real taxpayer/branch/authority/series/accreditation evidence or live approval has been supplied. All production transport/interface/response-verification flags remain false.

The current CSV download uses a rate-limited memory-bounded HTTP cursor. The internal specification proposed a background bulk-export job; such a durable asynchronous export service and measured very-large-tenant/report capacity are not established by this feature.
Document details show the latest30 existing lifecycle events; this does not fabricate missing historical evidence or establish independent immutable custody.

Full-list summary reconciliation and customer options require tenant data scans. This is not evidence of million-per-hour readiness, edge DDoS protection, multi-node cache enforcement, HA or tested disaster recovery.
Earlier seven-report audit and historical source manifests remain separate. This scoped report does not overwrite their historical hashes or mark external findings passed.
